exact_identities: out_Na+out_K-out_Cl-out_TA=0 for an electrically neutral secreted fluid
mandatory_bookkeeping: CO2 bath and apical exchange are separately signed; do not force both positive without state evidence.
No apical transcellular bicarbonate channel appears in this pinned parent; luminal bicarbonate enters through paracellular transport.
Luminal bicarbonate contributes +1 TIC and +1 TA per inward HCO3; apical CO2 contributes TIC only.
Luminal solute outflows remove every balanced amount, and must obey neutral outflow charge if neutral saliva is assumed.
If P and K are aggregated in cell balances retain Pa and Ka or declared source allocation variables for luminal Na/K bookkeeping.
No independent arbitrary acid/TA sink is present in the pinned parent. Adding one would change architecture and could erase genuine alkalinity constraints.
Finite buffer cannot be used as a sustained source of TA; closed hydration and dissociation conserve TIC/TA.
At steady state amount storage derivatives are zero. This excludes transient storage depletion or accumulation and does not prove physiological pH/volume.
direction_policy: Use nonnegative loading/export variables only as a clearly stated conditional transport sector, not a globally proven thermodynamic domain.
NHE inward affinity is ln(Na_o*H_i/(Na_i*H_o)); AE2 inward affinity ln(Cl_o*HCO3_i/(Cl_i*HCO3_o)); NKCC inward ideal stoichiometric affinity ln(Na_o*K_o*Cl_o^2/(Na_i*K_i*Cl_i^2)).
NBC inward affinity is ln(Na_o*HCO3_o^2/(Na_i*HCO3_i^2))+Vb/VT. Its sign cannot follow from stoichiometry alone.
Passive CO2 direction follows the compartment CO2 gradient; paracellular and channel directions additionally require electrochemical potentials.
A frozen dynamic reference supplies a sign only at that state. It does not validate directions throughout the LP region.
Equal AE4 cation routing is a parent model construction, not an experimentally established whole-cycle stoichiometry or universal thermodynamic guarantee.
bound_provenance_warnings: CO2 permeability values 0.02 and 0.01 fmol/s/mM are NEW_MODELING_DECISION; not measured capacities.
NBC default capacity 0.11570913197464398 fmol/s is an algebraically constructed WT feasibility scale, not measured abundance.
AE2 0.005 fmol/s is a placeholder capacity; not directly measured physiology.

Task44 conditional NHE upper bound 0.08202591 and AE4-without-NBC upper bound 0.04351295 fmol/s rely on inherited kinetic model, carrier amounts and pH>=6.6; they cannot silently become independent experimental bounds.
Speciation pH bracket [3,11] is numerical, not a physiological admissibility range.
Apical pump/K fractions 0.10 are modelling values; retain topology but do not call these measured localisation fractions.
Steady TA balance constrains flux support, not physiological pH: feasible TIC/TA amount concentrations and volume remain untested unless additional evidence is imposed.
